thread:
Lena Ortiz: Dropping a new iteration of the Alerting > SLO config panel. Focus: clearer threshold copy, suppression presets, and notification preview placement. Link: https://figma.redwood/s/iter-7. Quick sanity check?

Tom Becker: skimmed  immediate reaction: threshold line is confusing. Users read "0.25%" but expect counts. Can we append an example (approx.) like: "~4 errors / 10k reqs"? Also collapse long units into tooltip.

Jaya Patel: yes to example counts. Also flag for localization if we bake absolute numbers; use "approx" to avoid hard guarantees.

Lena Ortiz: plan: add inline "approx count" under the threshold slider and a tooltip for the calculation.

Evan Wu: preview placement: I prefer a right-side flyout on desktop so the SLO form isn't shuffled. For mobile collapse inline with a small sample row and "open preview" CTA.

Tom Becker: accessibility nits: contrast on the preset pills is low when selected. Need WCAG AA. Also keyboard focus on the pills should be visible (not just color).

Jaya Patel: multiselect channel chips: make them reachable by tab, support delete with Backspace/Delete, and include aria-labels like "Remove channel #alerts". For screen readers announce when suppression is applied: "Notifications silenced for X channels until 14:00 UTC".

design-bot: Accessibility scan: issues found: contrast on preset pills, missing aria-live announcement for suppression state. See https://ci.redwood/a11y/AL-672

Lena Ortiz: thanks. I'll update colors, add focus outlines, and wire an aria-live region for suppression state. Also changing copy: "Temporarily mute" -> "Silence notifications" across the panel.

Tom Becker: Copy suggestion: Under suppression timepicker add microcopy: "Only chosen channels will be silenced. Use presets or create a custom window." Keeps it explicit.

Evan Wu: one more: the preview should display both rolling and calendar-aligned examples (e.g., 30m rolling vs 00:00-01:00 daily window) so users understand behavior.

Lena Ortiz: good call  I'll add a small toggle in the preview: "Show calendar-aligned examples". Will push updated figma and ping for another quick pass. Thanks all :thumbsup:
